about: Home tiles and left-bar items for the Auto-Fixer GUI. One line per tile: add a tile here, not in the code. '&' marks the access-key letter (Alt+letter). icon = a Segoe Fluent Icons / Segoe MDL2 Assets codepoint (built into Windows 10 and 11). action = what the GUI runs; a tile tagged CHG must use an action that asks first (repair, cleanup) or 'soon'; 'soon' tiles say the window does not do this yet and point to AutoFix.bat. Codepoints from TEAM Creative (CRTV-0053): check each in Character Map.

tiles.label: Run a &scan
tiles.description: Reads this PC's logs for crashes and failures. Read-only: nothing is changed.

tiles.label: View fin&dings
tiles.description: What a saved scan found, with each finding's details and log entries. Reads the saved file only.

tiles.label: &Repair Windows files
tiles.description: SFC and DISM repairs, one step or all. Each step says what it changes and asks first.

tiles.label: &Network and domain
tiles.description: Network status, domain check, join or leave a domain, sign-in source. Use AutoFix.bat for now.

tiles.label: &Clean up
tiles.description: Disk Cleanup and Optimize drives. Shows what it removes or changes and asks first.

tiles.label: &Office and Outlook
tiles.description: Office repair and Outlook data files. Use AutoFix.bat for now.

tiles.label: Pr&inters
tiles.description: Checks the Print Spooler and printers, then fixes: test page, stuck jobs, spooler, default printer, add or remove printers.

tiles.label: View the last re&port
tiles.description: Opens the newest saved scan report in your browser.

tiles.label: Open the logs folder in E&xplorer
tiles.description: Opens this PC's Auto-Fixer logs folder in File Explorer.

footer.label: Se&ttings
footer.description: Mode, privacy, internet, screen style and theme.
